messages:
maria: Heads-up — we just hit a compatibility snag: internal routing header change landed in the proxy, and the TS client started dropping route hints in some edge cases.
aj: ah, which header? the one that encodes preferred_path?
sasha: it looks like `x-rd-route` got normalized to lowercase somewhere in the Go proxy rewrite, and our TS lib canonicalizes differently. result: requests end up in fallback pool.
maria: exact header is `X-RD-Route-Policy` in older SDKs, new proxy emits `x-rd-route-policy`. not a big deal for http servers, but our SDK header sanitizer is strict.
kevin: that explains the spike in Dedicated fallback metrics this morning. console showed +18% fallback on a canary tenant.
devex: can we do a quick shim in the SDKs instead of forcing a proxy rollback? shipping shims is less risky for customers.
aj: agree. propose: TS + Py accept both casings, Go normalizes to lower-case when building headers. patch plan: 1) accept both; 2) log a single debug msg; 3) add telemetry tag `routehdr_compat:v1`.
sasha: also need console mapping change — the per-route dashboard currently keys on the header name string. if both versions flow in, we should canonicalize at ingest so charts don't split.
ryan: I can add an ingest-side normalization in the telemetry pipeline. quick regex: `(?i)x-?rd-?route(-policy)?` -> `x-rd-route-policy`. but that will need a deploy and backfill for the last 3 hours of data.
maria: timeline? we need a mitigation before the next office hours demo at 4pm.
kevin: infra-bot reports current deploy window at 3:10pm, but we can push a small ingestion config earlier if it's low-risk.
infra-bot: deploy-window check: critical-patch window at 15:10 UTC allowed for telemetry-config changes. non-critical infra changes scheduled at 19:00 UTC.
devex: for SDKs, small patch to TS/py takes ~1hr including tests + canary publish. Go might be trickier because of header canonicalization in net/http.
aj: for Go client: set req.Header.Set("X-RD-Route-Policy", value) after setting raw header to ensure canonical key. also add a regression test that simulates proxy lowercasing.
sasha: console work: I'll make the ingestion normalizer idempotent and tag existing route keys with `normalized_key`. backfill: adhoc job to squash the split keys into a single aggregate.
kevin: ops: let's throttle the backfill to avoid overload. target 5k events/sec.
ryan: noted. I'll wire a feature flag for the normalizer so we can flip quickly if something weird happens.
maria: OK: action items — aj: patch TS/py (canary today). aj: ensure telemetry flag `routehdr_compat:v1` is emitted. kevin + ryan: ingestion normalizer + backfill behind flag. sasha: console dashboard mapping updates. aim to complete by 15:45 UTC.
aj: starting TS patch now, will post canary link.
kevin: I'll open a short postmortem template in incidents channel in case this escalates, but current plan is mitigation-first.
maria: thanks — keep updates here, tagging @devex if anything UX-blocking appears. :thumbsup:
